hostingRegion: Portfolio data stays on the device; market-data providers process online requests under their own policies.
backupRetention: The app creates no cloud portfolio backups. Local data remains until app data is cleared or the app is uninstalled.
logRetention: Fincake does not operate a server-side request-log or analytics service. External providers may retain IP addresses and request logs under their own policies; retention periods vary and are not controlled by Fincake.
